title: Clustering and file pruning
objectives: Say how min and max values per file let a query skip files
Work out which files a filter must read
Explain why liquid clustering or Z-ordering makes fewer files match

exercises.prompt: file_stats has each data file's smallest and largest sold_on. List the files a query for sold_on = 2026-10-15 must open, in file_name order.
hints: A file can hold 15 October whenever its range covers that day, not only when it starts on it.
WHERE min_date <= DATE '2026-10-15' AND max_date >= DATE '2026-10-15'
